name: IccmFollowUpVisit
title: iCCM follow-up visit
description: At the follow-up visit, a child who is not better, is worse, or shows any danger sign is referred urgently; a child who is better closes the follow-up.

action.title: Refer urgently to the health facility

expression.expression: (%visit.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'condition').answer.value.code contains 'same') or (%visit.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'condition').answer.value.code contains 'worse') or (%visit.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'danger-sign').answer.value contains true)
